subject: SIG intake: SCIM change stream + SAML assertion samples for access lineage
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <security@valorhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Shah <maya.shah@valorhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake: SCIM change stream + SAML assertion samples for access lineage

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — Valor is running a SIG intake next Wednesday and our audit team needs a small packet to validate provisioning, federation, and role ownership for a scoped set of users. Can you confirm you can provide the following by EOD Tuesday (2026-02-04)?

Requested artifacts (scope: redwood-inference.com, last 90 days unless noted):
- SCIM delta export (adds/updates/deletes) for user and group objects, CSV or JSONL preferred.
- 3-5 SAML assertion samples showing NameID/email and role/group attributes (redact PII if needed).
- RBAC role -> owner map (who is the owner for each role and last owner confirmation date).
- List of privileged service accounts and their scopes (just names + purpose).
- A short note on how least-privilege reviews are scheduled (owner cadence).

I attached our intake workbook to help line items up. If you have a preferred redaction template we can accept that. Also please share any links (Drive/Share) where you’ll drop the artifacts and point us to a single contact for follow-up.

We’ll copy audits@valorhealth.com after confirmation.

Thanks,
Jenna Ortiz
Security Program Manager
Valor Health

[attachment: SIG-Intake-Questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Ortiz <security@valorhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: SCIM change stream + SAML assertion samples for access lineage

Hi Jenna — appreciate the template and the clear scope.

Short answer: yes, we can provide the artifacts you listed. High-level plan and constraints:
- SCIM delta: we’ll export deltas for users and groups (2025-11-06 through 2026-02-03), delivered as a zipped CSV bundle. We will scrub direct PII (email will be tokenized in a parallel column) and include an index mapping of tokens to internal IDs for your audit team under NDA if required.
- SAML assertions: 5 samples (production auth flow) with timestamps and included attributes. We will remove raw session tokens and keep assertion structure intact.
- RBAC owner map: will include role name, owner (internal alias), owner confirmation date, and last modified date.
- Privileged service accounts: list + short description and last activity date.
- Least-privilege cadence: short narrative (one paragraph) and the policy doc link.

ETA: we’ll aim to drop a first bundle by EOD 2026-02-04 and a final redacted package by EOD 2026-02-05. If audits@valorhealth.com needs earlier access, let me know and we can escalate.

Irene (security ops) will own the artifact drop; cc’ing here. Sean, I’ll let you coordinate any commercial gating if needed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 11:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake: SCIM change stream + SAML assertion samples for access lineage

Jenna / Jordan — attaching the first drop per Jordan’s plan. Notes below and what’s inside.

Attachment bundle (uploaded to restricted Drive folder; link below):
- scim-deltas-202510-202602.csv.zip (zipped CSV; includes change_type, object_type, object_id_token, changed_at)
- saml-assertion-samples-2026-02.txt (5 assertions; NameID/email tokenized, attributes shown)
- rbac-owner-map-202602.csv (role, owner_alias, owner_confirmed_at, last_modified)

Redaction choices and provenance:
- We tokenized user email addresses in a stable token column (user_token) and preserved internal user IDs in a separate column for footprint tracing. If Valor requires a mapping file that links tokens to actual emails, we will provide it under an executed NDA and an approved access list.
- SAML samples show attribute statements and Audience/Issuer values; we removed raw session ids and any long-lived tokens.
- SCIM deltas were generated from our provisioning service logs (source: provisioning-db v2 export). Timestamps are in UTC.

Small caveats:
- Service account scope is provided as an owner-declared list; for deeper activity logs (API call traces) we’ll need a bit more time to pull from telemetry.
- For privileged-role modifications older than 12 months our archival process stores historic owner attributions in a different datastore; if you need >12 months we can include that in a follow-up.

Drive link (restricted access granted to jenna.ortiz@valorhealth.com and maya.shah@valorhealth.com): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_restricted_access

I’ve attached a short manifest inside the folder describing files and checksums. If the audit requires native SAML debug logs (AuthnRequests/Responses), call that out — we will need an approval ticket and a brief justification.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

2) For the RBAC owner map, please add an email alias column for owner contact where possible (we understand if some are group aliases).

The Drive link works and we confirmed we can access the zipped CSVs. If you can drop the service-account event extract by EOD tomorrow (2026-02-06) that would close our intake. We can execute the NDA mapping request immediately if you send an access form.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this will keep us on schedule for SIG intake next week.
